CatalogFilterMode/CatalogSortMode (L28-29), SignalCatalogSelectionProps {selectedSignals,onToggle,max?} (L31-36) and SignalCatalogPanelProps (L38-52) ported field-for-field; the only change is the DOM-only `className` wrapper prop (L46-47) -> a `style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>` composition hook, matching the Skeleton/FadeIn/Input parity convention. tableMaxHeight default '60vh' (L51, L77) preserved as a string and resolved to a numeric RN maxHeight via Dimensions ('Nvh' -> N% of window height).

The table area (L273-303): isLoading -> 8 height-48 Skeletons (L275-277); filtered.length>0 -> a vertical ScrollView (maxHeight=resolveMaxHeight(tableMaxHeight)) wrapping the inlined DataTable with tableId 'telemetry:signal-catalog', compact, pagination{defaultPageSize:50}, keyExtractor signal.name, emptyMessage t('signalGap.noMatch') (L278-289); else the centred signals.length===0 ? noData : noMatch message (L290-296); and the dataUpdatedAt>0 footer (L298-302) with t('signalGap.lastRefreshed') + a relative TimeStamp. Inlined native Badge: web <span size='sm' dot> pill -> a rounded-full View with a tinted surface/border, an optional status dot and a caption AppText; all four variants this panel uses (neutral/success/warning/danger) map to the surfaceRaised/success/warning/danger theme tokens. Inlined native StatCard: web neon-class card -> a rounded card with a label, a bold value and a boxed SemanticIcon glyph tinted by the icon's own semantic tone. Inlined native ToggleChip: web <Button ghost sm> -> a bordered Pressable tinting cyan (filter) or violet (sort) when active. Inlined native TimeStamp: the value union (string|number|Date|null|undefined), the '—' guard, an absolute en-US format and an honoured 'relative' override (the footer passes format='relative'); RN has no hover so the alternate-format Tooltip is dropped. Inlined native DataTable (subset): Column<T>{key,header,className?,render,visibleOnMobile?}, data, keyExtractor, compact, pagination{defaultPageSize}, emptyMessage, tableId; className 'w-8' -> a fixed 32pt checkbox cell, 'text-right' -> a right-aligned cell, visibleOnMobile accepted for parity but every column renders (RN shows the full catalog, matching the EventHistoryTable port); pagination slices at 50 with a Prev/Next pager shown only when totalPages>1 and the page resets to 1 on row-count change.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/StyleSheet/Dimensions/Platform + StyleProp/TextStyle/ViewStyle types), the already-ported native Skeleton/FadeIn/Input, the shared apps/native AppText/GlassPanel/SemanticIcon, the theme tokens (colors/spacing) and the useSignalGaps hook. SI contract honoured: the panel reads live signal values straight from the API and never converts units, so no mi/min/mph/kwh/kw/psi suffixes are introduced. Verified with `cd apps/native; npm run typecheck` (exit 0), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (exit 0, the 2 dynamic-flexGrow inline-style hits are warnings only), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (65 suites / 410 tests pass, incl. the added __tests__/SignalCatalogPanel.test.tsx: 9 tests covering the summary counts + status badges + refresh affordances, the 8 loading skeletons, the empty no-data message, the title/showSummary=false branch, the Stale Only filter dropping active signals, the selection checkbox toggle, the selection max gating, and unit tests for getCatalogStalenessStyle + formatStaleness).
